content.short: Longbow is an RWA lending layer on Robinhood Chain for borrowing against tokenized stocks.
content.description: Longbow is an RWA lending layer for Robinhood Chain where lenders supply USDG and borrowers post collateral. Accepted collateral spans tokenized stocks, other real-world assets and memecoins, each with its own risk parameters. The design puts equity-backed borrowing on the same chain the tokenized equities themselves settle on.
content.meta: Lend USDG and borrow against tokenized equities, the brokerage margin account rebuilt onchain.
